deduplication.scope_separation: The current consumption-attestation delta correctly separates opened manifest-bound shards from loaded model state. This successor narrows a second boundary: source checkpoint bytes, realized post-load state, and parameters actually exercised by a particular forward are three distinct evidence scopes.

observed_project_gap.finding: A deterministic post-load in-memory state digest is useful but is not by itself an equality proof against source checkpoint bytes, because the loader may apply declared dtype, device, key-mapping, offload, fusion, tied-weight or other version-specific transformations. Conversely, hashing the complete realized state and binding a forward to it does not prove that every parameter/buffer was actually read on that execution path.
observed_project_gap.risk: Overloading one field such as consumed_identity_match can silently collapse SOURCE_CHECKPOINT_IDENTITY, REALIZED_MODEL_STATE_IDENTITY and FORWARD_EXECUTION_PATH_COVERAGE into one claim.
observed_project_gap.selection_effect: Candidate comparison can become confounded if BASE, POSTTRAINED and TARGET_MEASURED are loaded under materially different transform plans even when each has a valid source manifest.

external_method_evidence.finding: Transformers documents that dtype controls the dtype used to instantiate model weights and device_map/offloading controls where model submodules reside.
external_method_evidence.implication: The realized model state is a function of source bytes plus the exact load/transform plan, not source bytes alone.

external_method_evidence.finding: Transformers documents disable_mmap, device_map, dtype and fusion_config loading controls; fusion can alter inference behavior.
external_method_evidence.implication: These controls belong in selection-grade load identity and must not remain implicit.

external_method_evidence.finding: safetensors load_file exposes mmap and pread backends and load_model reports missing/unexpected keys.
external_method_evidence.implication: Opened-file observation, source tensor identity, load coverage and realized state are separable proof objects.

external_method_evidence.finding: PyTorch state_dict includes parameters and persistent buffers; Module.to can move and cast parameters/buffers.
external_method_evidence.implication: A post-load state manifest can observe the realized module state, but source-to-state reconciliation must explicitly account for allowed transformations.

proposed_scope_ladder.proof_object: immutable checkpoint/tokenizer/config/template/file manifests with exact revisions and hashes
proposed_scope_ladder.does_not_prove: loader opened or realized those bytes

proposed_scope_ladder.proof_object: manifest-bound loader path/open observation plus pre/post file hashes
proposed_scope_ladder.does_not_prove: exact tensor values resident in the model after transformation

proposed_scope_ladder.proof_object: deterministic manifest over post-load parameter and persistent-buffer names, dtypes, shapes and raw value digests, bound to exact runtime/load plan
proposed_scope_ladder.does_not_prove: every state element was exercised by the observed forward

proposed_scope_ladder.proof_object: S2 digest + exact model mode/runtime/input identity + forward receipt + pre/post immutability check or typed allowed-mutation manifest
only if scientifically required: versioned module/parameter use coverage or equivalent causal/path instrumentation

source_tensor_manifest: source shard and byte-range or safetensors metadata reference where available
realized_state_manifest: all named parameters and required persistent buffers
device placement recorded separately from logical value identity
raw-value digest without implicit dtype conversion
unsupported tensor subclasses/quantized states fail closed unless a versioned adapter exists
reconciliation_rules: identity mapping plus unchanged dtype requires exact logical value equality
declared dtype cast requires a version-pinned deterministic expected-transform rule; do not compare source and realized raw bytes directly
key remaps/tied weights require explicit one-to-one or many-to-one provenance mapping
offloaded/disk-resident state requires equivalent identity evidence at the realized execution boundary
unknown transformation means reconciliation UNKNOWN, not PASS
forward_binding: bind exact S2 realized-state digest to forward receipt
bind exact rendered input/tensors and runtime mode
verify state digest unchanged across the forward unless a typed expected-mutation set is declared
do not label S3 as literal every-parameter consumption

matched_candidate_rule.principle: Selection fairness requires either one common load-transform plan across candidates or an explicit arm variable for every unavoidable plan difference.
matched_candidate_rule.promotion_boundary: This contract can establish selection-grade identity comparability only. It cannot select a winner, prove low-refusal retention, prove dynamic binding, prove J-Space causality or mint training credit.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A transformation-aware source-to-realized-state proof will eliminate false equivalence between candidates that opened the expected files but instantiated materially different effective model states.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: For the frozen Qwen3.5 candidates the current load plans may be sufficiently identical that the added contract produces no practical discrimination.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminator: Run the contract on one frozen candidate twice under identical settings and once with a single controlled dtype change; identical runs must reconcile to the same logical S2 identity while the dtype-changed arm must be explicitly different or transformed under the preregistered rule.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Keeping S2 realized-state identity separate from S4 execution-path use will prevent overclaiming checkpoint consumption without requiring expensive per-parameter tracing for ordinary matched selection.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Scientific promotion of J-Space mechanisms may eventually need fine-grained execution-path coverage, making S4 essential for some assays.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminator: Use S0-S3 for checkpoint eligibility; introduce S4 only for a preregistered mechanism test whose claim logically depends on a specific component being exercised.

execution_decision.reason: Current Trigger-2 global runtime-quiescence gate remains unresolved and no separately re-entered exact execution authority was used. This is a source/research delta only.

training_generation_decision.reason: Identity/metrology closure has higher information value than corpus growth at the current blocked admission frontier.
